blocks.text: Collects hunger nutrient from matching modules, supported food values and a matching nutrition network; fills an appropriate destination module.

rows: Supply food or a module with hunger in the input role.
Put the destination Hunger/Nutrition Module in the special module slot.
Connect mature Amethyst leaves through matching piping/logs for world collection.

blocks.text: FE is not the stored hunger quantity. A full module, exhausted food source or denied leaf harvest can pause transfer.

Read the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.
